source.scope: Read-only CPU audit of existing checkpoints on cached decision states. No training, inference policy or live-run changes.

resolved_initial_blocker.issue: The original all_valid regular_denied_by_verification and two denied_but_* statistics used mask & ~verified. A low-raw candidate does not need verification for its regular action, so the original counters attributed nonexistent regular denials and could compare an invalid pause label.
resolved_initial_blocker.source_evidence: Existing select_actions uses regular_valid = valid & (~writes | verified), where writes is raw_score > .84.
resolved_initial_blocker.minimal_fix: Define denied = eligible & ~verified and use mask & denied for all three denial statistics.

source_checks.loading: Existing load_data enforces partition, completed source receipt, finite arrays, causal decision protocol, valid original keep and action-valid consistency. The script checks checkpoint c1_head against cache head and strictly loads the existing checkpoint into a CPU eval model.
source_checks.shapes: valid, raw_score, current_iou, risk logits and verified are [B,7,5]; target_probability is [B,7,5,2]; scores/action utility are [B,7,5,2]. Last-axis regular/pause subtraction and chosen [row,region,candidate] indexing are correct.
source_checks.gt_boundary: forward(model,batch) filters to DECISION_FIELDS. select_actions is called before the audit reads current_iou or computes action_utility. GT class masks and BCE targets only score the already-produced decisions and never control model inputs, availability, gates, thresholds or selection.
source_checks.eligible: valid & (raw_score > .84), equal to cached action_valid[...,1]. A regular action may exist without a template write; write_eligible is not the model verification outcome.
source_checks.quality_groups: Within write_eligible, current IoU >= .5 is correct, IoU < .2 is wrong, and .2 <= IoU < .5 is uncertain. These three masks are disjoint and exhaust eligible candidates. They are localization categories, not sensor identity or reliability labels.
source_checks.risk_labels: joint_event_bce_sum uses eligible & (IoU < .2) and equals the existing risk training label on valid candidates. conditional_bce_sum and risk_brier_sum instead use IoU < .2. Only eligible groups supply conditional write-risk calibration; all_valid conditional/Brier fields diagnose localization labels and are not the original training risk loss. Final source scope now states this distinction.
source_checks.aggregation: Integer counts and per-candidate float sums accumulate across batches without averaging batch means. Candidate counts are the denominator for sums; the three eligible subgroups partition write_eligible. all_valid and write_eligible overlap and should not be added together.
source_checks.same_candidate_comparison: pause_score_gap and pause_teacher_utility_gap consistently mean pause minus regular for the same candidate. Reference and same-region search-cost terms cancel in the score difference. Utility remains the existing current/frozen-C1-future/wrong-update formula, with no added search-cost charge.
source_checks.writes: The script writes only its requested JSON path, creates its parent directory and prints the receipt. It does not save or modify a checkpoint, source module, dataset, live process or training configuration.

independent_cpu_checks.method: Compile current diagnostic source; execute its actual aggregation AST against 16 real own-TRAIN label rows with deterministic synthetic output tensors. Execute existing select_actions, action_utility and a forward-input spy. No module construction, neural forward, backward or optimizer by reviewer.
independent_cpu_checks.float_sum_interpretation: Normal float32 reduction-order difference; integer counts and query rows match exactly. No bitwise float-sum claim is made.

actual_cache_metadata_read_only.purpose: Confirms real low-raw populations, group denominators, shape compatibility and actual writable states for the structural witness. No neural evaluation was used to obtain these metadata counts.

risk_only_witness_review.construction: Select the first actual writable original-C1 keep from the loaded partition. Existing load_data already guarantees that keep is valid. Create a separate fresh RecoverabilityModules(c1), set only action[-1].bias[5] to10, run under no_grad and select at the unchanged .03 threshold.
risk_only_witness_review.initialization_isolation: Fresh action/search final weights are zero; action advantage differences are zero and regular/pause harm outputs match. Fresh gate target probability exceeds .5. Region net value is -.01, so search cannot trigger. The checkpoint-loaded model and checkpoint tensors are not modified.
risk_only_witness_review.score_mechanism: For a writable keep, its regular relative score is0 and its pause advantage from risk alone is .025*sigmoid(10), approximately .024998864. This is below the unchanged .03 replacement threshold. The witness asserts both the gap and retention of regular keep without search.
risk_only_witness_review.meaning: A structural coefficient witness on an actual cached state with a separately initialized model. It does not measure a trained checkpoint's response to a risk intervention, prove risk is the sole learned cause, or recommend a threshold change.

actual_main_agent_m0_v2.provenance: Executed by main agent in private CPU context; reviewer read the actual receipt. m0_v2 predates the final explanatory scope-string edit; tested computational logic is unchanged.

interpretation_limits: Grouped counts cover all valid cached candidates in all seven regions. They characterize candidate-level verification conditions, including currently unavailable extra regions, and are not counts of executed online template writes or denied live events.

For query rows where write_eligible is false, the pause action has no valid cached rollout label. Its reported pause score/teacher utility difference must not be interpreted as a legal regular-versus-pause counterfactual. Corrected denial aggregates already restrict these comparisons to eligible candidates.
The two-query M0 contains no writable candidates in its aggregate; it checks zero-denial behavior. Its additional query4 witness is explicitly separate and not folded into the aggregate denominator.
Future pause utilities use frozen-C1 continuations. These cached-state statistics do not establish full-policy future outcomes or full98 tracking improvements.
No new deployment threshold, gating policy, architecture, loss or training recommendation is emitted by this audit. Current four pairwise jobs remain outside its mutation scope.
